title: SMOK LP2 Replacement Coils
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
The
SMOK
LP2 Coils are specially designed for leak-proof vaping. Each coil in this series uses 3 silicone rings to provide tightness.
SMOK LP2 replacement coils are compatible with the
SMOK Nord 50 Watt Pod Vape Device
.
Available in:
Meshed 0.23ohm DL
Meshed 0.4ohm, Best 25W
DC 0.6ohm, 15-25W
